exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Mothers who received a CS and were documented as a referral
cohort: 77,242 live births and 3,734 stillbirths at 10 facilities in Busoga Region, East-Central Uganda and Migori County, Kenya
finding: Caesarean section births were at higher risk for stillbirth, pre-discharge neonatal mortality, and maternal mortality compared with vaginal deliveries in this context.
mod_finding: Mothers who received a CS had a lower risk of stillbirth if they were documented as a referral.
